assertions.description: navigator.userActivation exists — the transient-activation model whose gate the delegated "popup" token bypasses.
The window-side Capability Delegation framework this proposal extends is live: postMessage with an unrecognised delegate capability throws NotSupportedError instead of silently ignoring the option.
ServiceWorkerRegistration.prototype.showNotification is a function — the notification whose click grants the transient "popup" capability token.

client.postMessage(msg, { delegate: 'popup' }) OUTSIDE a trusted notificationclick throws NotAllowedError in a supporting browser; an unsupporting browser delivers the message with the unknown member ignored (the delegation-probe concept runs this exact call through the feature's service worker).
assertions.test: Requires a build with the CapabilityDelegationPopup flag (--enable-experimental-web-platform-features); no released Chrome implements it (ChromeStatus milestone: none). Observe live via /v157/popup-capability-delegation/delegation-probe/.

assertions.description: After a real notification click, the worker's {delegate:'popup'} message lets the focused client window call window.open() successfully without its own activation.
assertions.test: Requires the flagged build, a granted notification permission and a human notification click. Observe via /v157/popup-capability-delegation/notification-delegation-lab/ (delegate arm).

assertions.description: The delegated token on the receiving window lives 1 second: a window.open() delayed 1.5s after the message is popup-blocked.
assertions.test: Requires the flagged build and a notification click; the lab's 'token expiry' arm performs the delayed real call.

assertions.description: One notification click never yields two popups: the first window.open() consumes the token (and any activation), the second is blocked.
assertions.test: Requires the flagged build and a notification click; the lab's 'single-use invariant' arm performs both real calls.

assertions.description: delegate: 'popup' is only valid on Client.postMessage targeting a WindowClient; other worker messaging channels throw NotSupportedError.
assertions.test: Requires the flagged build plus dedicated/shared-worker targets; per the explainer's Delegation Channel Restrictions. Not yet exercisable in any released browser.
